description: V - Fußgängerzone Innenstadt / V_A_I_1977 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by apps.villingen-schwenningen.de. Urban development plan of the city of Villingen-Schwenningen. Pedestrian zone downtown Sub-area Rietstraße - Obere Straße. Use: Traffic area. The development plan contains the legally binding stipulations for the urban development order. In principle, the development plan must be developed from the land use plan. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "V - Pedestrian Street Downtown / V_A_I _1977" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Bauleitplanung, Villingen-Schwenningen, Bebauung, Bebauungsplan, Bodennutzung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://geoh.conterra:8080/oai-pmh-geo-harvest/harvesters/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
